snippet.title: SOL Shogunate Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
SOL Shogunate is a Samurai Space Opera Action-RPG set in an alt-future solar system where the way of the sword is law. Wishlist now: http://s.team/a/3219360 

As Yuzuki, the shattered heir to a massacred samurai clan, you’ll embark on a gravity-defying, blood-soaked path of revenge set to a pulse-pounding soundtrack. Sign-up for future playtests: https://chaos.firstlook.gg/

Coming to PC and consoles (when it's ready). 


--
